bean-leaf.mirrorRule: For the opposite side reflect all x coordinates as width-x.
bean-leaf.postprocess: Horizontal mirror, Lanczos resize to 512x320, remove disconnected alpha specks while retaining 2px antialias fringe.

repeat.policy: Align endpoint sockets; 1 source pixel overlap. End-strip crossfade is baked into this seamless export.

bean-stem.postprocess: Remove disconnected alpha specks; Lanczos resize384x512; register both32px end strips to114px opaque width centered192 with smooth64px transition bands; crossfade generated strips in premultiplied alpha, remove duplicate32px strip, resize vertically to512; normalize final endpoints114px centered192. Lossless PNG/WebP.
bean-stem.notes: Exactly two substantial intertwined stems. Source opaque endpoint width is2x the original stem's57px. Two small tendrils; no new leaf platforms or runtime code.

bean-branch.defaultDirection: thick stem socket left, tapered leaf socket right
bean-branch.postprocess: Sprite skill process single asset, largest component, threshold100 edgeThreshold150; crop [360,190,1704,550], resize240x64, paste[8,16] in256x96 canvas, remove disconnected alpha specks.

bean-colossus-stem.postprocess: Hard magenta key tolerance30; 1px edge contraction; component extraction; Lanczos normalization. Hard key preserves genuine violet crystal facets.
